decision.interpretation: The source-complete rank-64 one-pass recurrence clears the offline physical screen. It remains uncompiled, unmeasured, and quality-unqualified.

implemented_mechanism.consumer: One pass per request/KV-head/output tile carries the recurrent state through all causal query rows, maps query heads by h//2, normalizes numerator by denominator, and emits all 32x256 attention outputs to the unchanged o_proj.
implemented_mechanism.producer: Post-RMSNorm, post-RoPE Q/K use a request-independent learned 16x256x64 positive feature projection; post-RMSNorm V remains full 256-wide.
implemented_mechanism.rolling_eviction: Before position p enters, slot p mod 1,024 supplies exactly position p-1,024 and its outer product is subtracted; the new outer product is then added and overwrites that slot.
implemented_mechanism.state: Each request/local-layer/KV-head retains an FP32 64x256 numerator, FP32 rank-64 denominator, and a BF16 1,024-slot ring of projected K plus full-width V.

information_path_and_capacity_audit.causal_horizon: For row p, the state represents exactly [max(0,p-1023),p].
information_path_and_capacity_audit.gqa_mapping: query_head // 2 maps 32 Q heads to 16 KV heads
information_path_and_capacity_audit.rope_semantics: Feature projection consumes already-RoPE-applied Q/K; no summary or recurrent state is assigned an invented position.

limitations: No checkpoint, GPU, provider, training, or broad quality evaluation was used.
The CUDA/Triton path is source-complete but was not compiled or timed on target hardware.
The service figure is a conservative trace-calibrated physical model, not endpoint measurement.
Positive-feature recurrence intentionally changes local softmax-attention semantics.
The learned feature projection has no trained weights; quality recovery is unresolved.
Rank 96, a second full consumer pass, excess fixed overhead, or fallback above the reported bound invalidates promotion.

charged_costs: rolling-ring materialization and exact subtractive eviction
request ownership, positions, slots, metadata, graph variants
stream ordering, dispatch, and stock fallback
